address: 3106 N. Davidson St., Charlotte, NC, 28205, USA
bio: Set in NoDa, a neighborhood once known for its textile mills, this restaurant's name is a play on the past. Inside, it's rustic-cool with exposed beams and denim-covered banquettes. The action takes place at the counter; order a draft beer or craft cocktail and take it all in. Meanwhile, the menu is rooted in southern comfort. Be sure to order the devilled eggs and the crispy, fried chicken. Sides like homemade tater tots and mac & cheese make everything better. Don't skip dessert, especially the house-made banana pudding served in a Mason jar. Come lunchtime for hearty sandwiches or delicious brunch offerings on the weekends....
